title: "Snap 2D transforms to pixel" causes GPUParticles to jitter when parent moves in scaled sub viewport
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.3.stable

### System information

MacbookPro 2019 with 2.6 GHz 6-Core Intel Core i7 and AMD Radeon Pro 5300M 4 GB, Intel UHD Graphics 630 1536 MB

### Issue description

When a game is played within a Subviewport, stretched using a SubViewportContainer with 2D transforms snapped to pixel, spawned GPU particles jitter in place when a parent node of the particles is moved.

I would expect instead of them jittering, for the particles to either move a full pixel in space, or not move at all.

Here is a recording directly from the MVP attached to this issue:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7b4c216-f185-4311-8762-c8fcf55d1a13

This seems to be a similar bug to: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/71225, which had the same jitter even without the sub viewport scaling.

The working context is a pixel perfect game, where a small resolution game is played and then higher resolution is created by upscaling with the stretch. The same jitter is shown here within the game we are actually making, with the centre blue pixels jittering as the player moves smoothly in space

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fee18446-5b6d-4f5f-920c-3c485794c7b9

### Related Issues

- This problem seems somewhat related to this issue I just found: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/90105
- This could also even be a duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98764, which i didnt find initially. I am sorry about this

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a CanvasLayer
- Create a SubViewportContainer as a child of the CanvasLayer with stretch mode enabled with stretch sink set (for example 2)
- Create a Subviewport as a child of the SubViewportContainer and set "Snap 2D Transforms to Pixel" to true
- Create a moveable node (for example CharacterBody2D) as a child of the Subviewport
- Create a GPUParticles2D as a child of the movable player

For example: 

```
CanvasLayer
- SubViewportContainer
-- Subviewport
--- CharacterBody2D
---- GPUParticles2D
```

[particle-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28630872/particle-bug.zip)
